column1: # Columns: file under sys/, its lines in this tree, then the percentage of this
# tree's lines that survive (diff -w) in NetBSD 1.3 (branch netbsd-1-3),
# OpenBSD 1997-06 and OpenBSD 1999-12; "gone" = no file of that name.
# 90 or more in all three: a donor file that is nearly this one, so taking it
# changes the file and not its interfaces. Sorted by directory then name.
# Baseline is this tree (4.5BSD), not pristine Lite2, so its own fixes count as differences.
